answer: Each collapsed cluster gets one nadir weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. The walnut report exposes the merge explicitly at each echo. Because of that, a hostile operator who spins up 239 aliases from one source ends up with the same influence as one agent, paying 92 times the capital for one share. A farm of 3612 identities would post 4231 proofs and burn roughly 14 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
